actual_scope: Classify all cost-at-most-six terms in exact eight-term complex E8 decoders through 25 common punctures, and price their complete eight-term copy invoice. Sharp cost-six completion minimum 67; unrestricted decoder minimum at p=25 is 56; arbitrary nonparallel normals first attain cost six at p=26.
scope_change_reason: The donor assigned the complex supplier track. The catalogue masked-decoder card is used for metadata, but this is explicitly a deeper-puncture all-pairs side result beyond its inherited p<=24 theorem, not a masked or overcomplete construction.
bottleneck_link: Copied-information cost enters the binding complex supplier budget; this resolves whether the first allowed dimension-seven support drop opens a cheaper term for non-root normals.
stop_rule: One bounded p<=25 experiment, including all root support codimension-two minima and all compatible dual functionals; stop this route if the optimistic copy/port ratio cannot beat 7/13. Reserve the final 15 of 60 minutes for verification and handoff.
evidence: CERTIFICATE.json, verify.py and the code-disjoint Gram-minor checker check all 7560 boundary cuts, 32193 rational matrices and two complete 95-port decoders. README.md gives the quantified proof under inherited classification F6. Eight semantic package tests cover corrupt source, incomplete coverage, false kernels/ranks, wrong scale and undercharged total.
